description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_D1y_dirichlet_bc driven by problems/advection_2d_y_dirichlet_central.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — NY is the open metaparameter (NX is edge-closed at 8; the solution is constant in x and no x-operator appears). The rule is exercised as the advective y-term of a well-posed advection-diffusion decay problem (a two-sided fixed-value gradient reflects at an outflow y-wall in pure advection, so the physical y-diffusion supplies the boundary dissipation that makes it well posed; derivation in the problem file). The exact unforced solution e^{2y} + e^{-lambda t} e^{y} sin(pi y) (nonzero fixed-value y-walls gB=1, gT=e^2) decays parabolically, so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.05 are the clean O(dy^2) y-truncation dominated by the advective closure under test.
